title: Transit Authority / Receiving Clerk Statement
summary: Statement concerning archival cargo received without a corresponding dispatch record.
body:
Receiving clerk statement, depot 4:

"Box arrived sealed. No damage. Label said R-17-09. I checked the movement board and there was nothing there.

We checked again after unloading it. Still nothing.

There was a paper manifest inside the box, but the system copy wasn't there."

Statement ends.
